title.narrative: Partnership with the EU to improve competitiveness of the Palestinian private sector and create jobs

description.narrative: This activity Partnership with the EU to improve competitiveness of the Palestinian private sector and create jobs is a component of Palestinian Market Development Programme to Strengthen the Private Sector in the Occupied Palestinian Territories (OPTs) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £13,958,647. It works in the following sector(s): Small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) development, Business policy and administration.

mailing-address.narrative: Public Enquiry Point, Abercrombie House, Eaglesham Road, East Kilbride, Glasgow G75 8EA
